_comment: Copy this file to edge-function-secrets.json (gitignored), fill in real values, then run `pnpm supabase:secrets --apply`. These go to Supabase Vault — NEVER commit the filled-in copy. Keys starting with _ are ignored by the script. The functions read SUPABASE_URL / SUPABASE_ANON_KEY from the platform's auto-injected env (with NEXT_PUBLIC_-prefixed fallbacks), so no Supabase URL/key secrets are needed here. PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID IS required server-side (order/capture/cancel/resume token grants + webhook signature verification) even though the same value also ships to the browser as NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID. RESEND_API_KEY powers send-payment-email (leave empty to keep email notifications inert). NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is required before live traffic: checkout success/cancel URLs and the CORS origin derive from it (it may include a basePath for GitHub Pages project sites). PAYPAL_API_BASE is optional: unset = sandbox; set https://api-m.paypal.com for live. Only the Stripe publishable key and price id are truly browser-only (.env + GitHub Actions secrets, not here).
